title: Message Member to many contacts is sent as a bulk email with a one-click unsubscribe

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (thread: Check every email and message system)

detail: 2026-11-18: sendSpaceEmailDraftAsConversations sends a designed email to up to 500 contacts as separate one-to-one conversations, gated at canEmailContact(..., 'transactional') and with only a Message-ID header (lib/comms/conversation-compose.ts says a 1:1 note is not bulk). At that size it is a campaign: contacts who never opted in to marketing can get it and there is no List-Unsubscribe header. Owner call on the consent bar (ADR-821). Done when a multi-recipient send carries listUnsubscribeHeaders and the marketing consent bar above a small threshold.

verify.note: Fails on main today; passes once the fix lands.
